review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the code artifact for the ICML 2024 Autoformalizing Euclidean Geometry paper.
Inspection found 234 Lean files and more than 500 declaration-shaped items; Book/ contains formal Euclid propositions such as proposition_1, proposition_5, proposition_21, and proposition_46.
SystemE, UniGeo, E3, and AutoFormalization support the formal geometry language/proof pipeline and benchmark; no bounded path was demonstrated to be duplicate generated noise.
summary: Retain LeanEuclid in full: Book/SystemE/UniGeo and autoformalization sources jointly encode Euclidean geometry statements, semantics, tactics, and benchmark material.

review_evidence: AutoFormalization/example/Book/formalizations/5.lean: Contains proposition_42, _42', _42'', _42''' — formal proofs of Euclid Book 1 Prop 42 variants with parallelogram construction and area equivalence
AutoFormalization/example/UniGeo/Parallel/formalizations/1.lean: Contains theorem_1 — a formal theorem about parallel lines and angle sums using proposition_13, _15, _27
AutoFormalization/example/UniGeo/Parallel/formalizations/2.lean: Contains theorem_1 (different statement) — another parallel lines theorem using proposition_13, _15, _27
Book/Prop24.lean: Formal proof of Euclid Book 1 Proposition 24 (triangle side-angle-side inequality) using propositions 3, 4, 5, 13, 17, 19, 23
Book/Prop43.lean: Formal proof of Euclid Book 1 Proposition 43 (parallelogram complements) using proposition_34 and area lemmas
E3/Data/ApproxResult.lean: Defines ImpResult, PermutationResult, ApproxResult structures for approximate equivalence checking — no mathematical theorems
E3/Data/EvalCtx.lean: Defines EvalCtx structure and PropEvalM monad for equivalence checking evaluation context — infrastructure
E3/Engine/EquivCheck.lean: Implements evalSmt', checkFullIff, solveBwd, solveFwdLHS/RHS, checkIffApprox, solvePerms, approxChecker — SMT-based equivalence engine
E3/Engine/Main.lean: Defines runStdEquiv, runApproxEquiv, E3Main, parseArgs, runE3fromIO — main entry points for E3
E3/Util/Expr.lean: Expression utilities (getConsequentOf, getExprName, addBvars, renameBVars, mergeMaps, unfoldGeoAbbrevs, preprocessExpr) — meta-programming helpers
E3/Util/IO.lean: I/O utilities (writeResult, E3Env/Ctx/State, permInFile/OutFile, permChooser, readPermOutput, permutationHeuristic) — tooling infrastructure
SystemE/Meta/Tactics/Solve.lean: Implements euclid_apply, euclid_finish, EuclidStep, solveWithProvers, EuclidSolve — tactic framework for Euclidean proofs
lakefile.lean: Lake build configuration defining SystemE, Book, UniGeo, E3 libraries and check/cleanup/aggregate scripts — build metadata
tests/E3Regression.lean: Regression test for E3 proof caches and writeResult behavior — test code
summary: All 14 files retain searchable status. The 5 Book/AutoFormalization files contain formal Euclidean geometry theorems and proofs (Props 24, 42, 43 and UniGeo parallel theorems). The 6 E3 files implement an SMT-based equivalence checking engine (data structures, evaluation context, equivalence logic, main entry point, expression utilities, I/O) — these are formalization infrastructure, not mathematical content, but the prior review (RRV-d4935a9bd251-r1) explicitly retained 'Book/SystemE/UniGeo and autoformalization sources jointly encode Euclidean geometry statements, semantics, tactics, and benchmark material.' SystemE/Meta/Tactics/Solve.lean implements the euclid_apply/euclid_finish tactics used in those proofs. lakefile.lean is the build configuration. tests/E3Regression.lean is a regression test for the equivalence checker. Per FILTER-002/004/022/025, the hard-exclusion bar is not met: no prover-aware check shows these files lack formal mathematical declarations relevant to the corpus, the prior review set a retain-full precedent, and uncertainty defaults to retention.
